intro.text: A holy language spoken by the priest DaiKeen, the clergy of Kerzta's Ker'reen faith.

description.text: Khriss and Cynder learned some Karshad from Daysider books before arriving. When Cynder spoke it, the locals seemed to understand but quickly ran off in fear; only on hearing a priest use it did the party realise they had picked up a sacred tongue rather than the common one.
